_c2: Autonaming, a monthly task that will name the next post in the list

post-system._c4: Inside the inner worldborder, the posts are arranged in a grid, and can be named with /namepost
post-system._c5: Outside the outer worldborder, the posts are manually placed, and can be created with /createpost
post-system._c6: Distance between posts in the inner worldborder
post-system._c7: Distance between posts in the outer worldborder
post-system._c8: Width of the post, used for allowing TP commands, and used by /buildposts to center the structures
post-system._c9: Earned claimblocks needed for naming/creating a post. Griefdefender is required for this to work
